name: Naloxone Distribution Project (NDP)
description: California's Naloxone Distribution Project provides free naloxone and fentanyl test strips to eligible organizations working to prevent opioid overdose deaths in their communities. It does not serve individuals directly.
fullDescription: California's Naloxone Distribution Project provides free naloxone and fentanyl test strips to eligible organizations working to prevent opioid overdose deaths in their communities. It does not serve individuals directly.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free naloxone nasal spray (generic or Narcan brand)
- Free fentanyl test strips
- Shipped directly to approved organizations
- Available to eligible organizations statewide
howToGetIt: Organizations apply through the Department of Health Care Services' online NDP application. Eligible entities include community organizations (harm reduction groups, opioid coalitions), schools and universities, tribal entities, county public health and behavioral health departments, fire/EMS and first responders, and law enforcement. Fentanyl test strip requests require a business license, FEIN, or tax-exempt letter. Individuals can buy low-cost naloxone through CalRx.
keywords: NDP, naloxone, Narcan, free, nonprofit, fentanyl test strips, harm reduction, overdose prevention, opioid, community distribution
